title: Each Round line of a review record names the head that round read, and the merge gate checks the last round or a fix check read the live head
why: Coordinator, sent 15:28 CST Nov 8. Form: `Round 2: reviewer, sonnet, FAIL, 765158ded`. Incident: it voided records on #2224, #2296, #2235 and #2265 for listing rounds that read older heads, which decision pr-review-record allows, and withdrew the voids. A record does not show which head each round read, so lanes and the coordinator guessed, and 7 PRs stalled. Related: step record-after-each-round (#1678, #1908).
